notes: «أبي جعفر ع» is written inside the chain after «عن», so he stays a narrator (owner ruling 2); «أبيه» is Zakariya's father, named by relation only
The Prophet's closing sentence «وَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ص مَنْ أَلَحَّ» has no transmitter: a one-sentence report of the Prophet, left for ruling (rule 11)
